name: Control Chart (Box-Cox transformed)
description: I-MR with Box-Cox transform for non-normal data
whenToUse: Control-chart skewed, strictly positive data: a Box-Cox transformation makes them near-normal before I-MR limits are computed.
lambdaHint: In auto mode λ is fitted from the data; for Phase-II monitoring freeze it to the Phase-I value.
errPositiveOnly: Box-Cox requires strictly positive values. Filter the column or use Yeo-Johnson.
